blocks.html_en: get(&tree, key) performs a root-to-leaf search:

sentences.en: get(&tree, key) performs a root-to-leaf search:
sentences.zh: get(&tree, key) 执行从根到叶的搜索：

blocks.html_en: • Load tree.root from the Store.

sentences.en: Load tree.root from the Store.
sentences.zh: 从商店加载tree.root。

blocks.html_en: • Binary-search the current node's sorted keys.

sentences.en: Binary-search the current node's sorted keys.
sentences.zh: 对当前节点的排序键进行二分查找。

blocks.html_en: • In internal nodes, descend to the child whose span can contain the key.

sentences.en: In internal nodes, descend to the child whose span can contain the key.
sentences.zh: 在内部节点中，下降到其跨度可以包含该键的子节点。

blocks.html_en: • In a leaf, return the exact key's value or None.

sentences.en: In a leaf, return the exact key's value or None.
sentences.zh: 在叶子中，返回确切的键值或 None。

blocks.html_en: The expected complexity is O(log n) node visits.

sentences.en: The expected complexity is O(log n) node visits.
sentences.zh: 预期的复杂度是 O(log n) 节点访问。

blocks.html_en: Range APIs use similar positioning:

sentences.en: Range APIs use similar positioning:
sentences.zh: Range API 使用类似的定位：

blocks.html_en: • range(&tree, start, end) returns a lazy RangeIter.

sentences.en: range(&tree, start, end) returns a lazy RangeIter.
sentences.zh: range(&tree, start, end) 返回一个惰性 RangeIter。

blocks.html_en: • range_after(&tree, after_key, end) resumes strictly after a processed key.

sentences.en: range_after(&tree, after_key, end) resumes strictly after a processed key.
sentences.zh: range_after(&tree, after_key, end) 在处理过的键之后严格恢复。

blocks.html_en: • range_from_cursor(&tree, cursor, end) resumes from a stable RangeCursor.

sentences.en: range_from_cursor(&tree, cursor, end) resumes from a stable RangeCursor.
sentences.zh: range_from_cursor（&tree，cursor，end）从稳定的RangeCursor恢复。

blocks.html_en: • range_page(&tree, cursor, end, limit) reads bounded pages for checkpoints.

sentences.en: range_page(&tree, cursor, end, limit) reads bounded pages for checkpoints.
sentences.zh: range_page(&tree,cursor,end,limit) 读取检查点的有界页面。

blocks.html_en: • reverse_page(&tree, cursor, start, limit) and prefix_reverse_page(&tree, prefix, cursor, limit) read descending pages with a stable ReverseCursor.

sentences.en: reverse_page(&tree, cursor, start, limit) and prefix_reverse_page(&tree, prefix, cursor, limit) read descending pages with a stable ReverseCursor.
sentences.zh: verse_page(&tree,cursor,start,limit) 和 prefix_reverse_page(&tree,prefix,cursor,limit) 使用稳定的 ReverseCursor 读取降序页面。

blocks.html_en: • prove_range_page(&tree, cursor, end, limit) returns the same page plus a store-independent proof for the exclusive cursor window.

sentences.en: prove_range_page(&tree, cursor, end, limit) returns the same page plus a store-independent proof for the exclusive cursor window.
sentences.zh: Prove_range_page(&tree, Cursor, End, Limit) 返回同一页面以及独占光标窗口的独立于存储的证明。

blocks.html_en: • cursor(&tree, key) positions a cursor near a key.

sentences.en: cursor(&tree, key) positions a cursor near a key.
sentences.zh: cursor(&tree, key) 将光标定位在键附近。

blocks.html_en: • range_cursor(&tree, start, end) uses cursor traversal for bounded scans.

sentences.en: range_cursor(&tree, start, end) uses cursor traversal for bounded scans.
sentences.zh: range_cursor(&tree, start, end) 使用游标遍历进行有界扫描。

blocks.html_en: Range iteration performs an initial seek and then advances across leaves in sorted key order.

sentences.en: Range iteration performs an initial seek and then advances across leaves in sorted key order.
sentences.zh: 范围迭代执行初始查找，然后按排序的键顺序跨叶前进。

blocks.html_en: Write Path

sentences.en: Write Path
sentences.zh: 写入路径

blocks.html_en: put and delete are immutable operations.

sentences.en: put and delete are immutable operations.
sentences.zh: put 和delete 是不可变的操作。

blocks.html_en: Single-key writes:

sentences.en: Single-key writes:
sentences.zh: 单键写入：

blocks.html_en: • find_path walks from root to the target leaf.

sentences.en: find_path walks from root to the target leaf.
sentences.zh: find_path 从根节点走到目标叶子节点。

blocks.html_en: • The canonical streaming emitter replays the affected ordered span using the tree's persisted chunking policy and exact byte cap.

sentences.en: The canonical streaming emitter replays the affected ordered span using the tree's persisted chunking policy and exact byte cap.
sentences.zh: 规范流发射器使用树的持久分块策略和确切的字节上限重播受影响的有序范围。

blocks.html_en: • Emitted child summaries stream through affected parent levels.

sentences.en: Emitted child summaries stream through affected parent levels.
sentences.zh: 发出的子摘要会流经受影响的父级别。

blocks.html_en: • New or changed nodes are collected and flushed through the store.

sentences.en: New or changed nodes are collected and flushed through the store.
sentences.zh: 新的或更改的节点被收集并通过存储刷新。

blocks.html_en: • The method returns a new Tree with the new root CID.

sentences.en: The method returns a new Tree with the new root CID.
sentences.zh: 该方法返回带有新根 CID 的新树。

blocks.html_en: The original tree remains valid and shares any unchanged subtrees.

sentences.en: The original tree remains valid and shares any unchanged subtrees.
sentences.zh: 原始树仍然有效并共享任何未更改的子树。

blocks.html_en: Append-heavy single-key writes can use the rightmost-path fast path when the key belongs after the current right edge.

sentences.en: Append-heavy single-key writes can use the rightmost-path fast path when the key belongs after the current right edge.
sentences.zh: 当键属于当前右边缘之后时，追加大量单键写入可以使用最右路径快速路径。

blocks.html_en: Batch Mutation Path

sentences.en: Batch Mutation Path
sentences.zh: 批量突变路径

blocks.html_en: batch(&tree, mutations) is the default API for multiple updates:

sentences.en: batch(&tree, mutations) is the default API for multiple updates:
sentences.zh: batch(&tree,mutations)是多次更新的默认API：

blocks.html_en: Use batch_with_stats or append_batch_with_stats when callers need telemetry for an operation. Stats-bearing and parallel entry points are adapters over the same canonical writer; they cannot select a different boundary or tree algorithm.

sentences.en: Use batch_with_stats or append_batch_with_stats when callers need telemetry for an operation.
sentences.zh: 当调用者需要对操作进行遥测时，请使用batch_with_stats或append_batch_with_stats。

sentences.en: Stats-bearing and parallel entry points are adapters over the same canonical writer; they cannot select a different boundary or tree algorithm.
sentences.zh: 统计数据和并行入口点是同一规范编写器上的适配器；他们无法选择不同的边界或树算法。

blocks.html_en: Batch processing:

sentences.en: Batch processing:
sentences.zh: 批处理：

blocks.html_en: • Sorts mutations by key.

sentences.en: Sorts mutations by key.
sentences.zh: 按键对突变进行排序。

blocks.html_en: • Deduplicates duplicate keys with last-write-wins semantics.

sentences.en: Deduplicates duplicate keys with last-write-wins semantics.
sentences.zh: 使用最后写入获胜语义来消除重复键。

blocks.html_en: • Detects append-only batches and updates the rightmost path directly when possible.

sentences.en: Detects append-only batches and updates the rightmost path directly when possible.
sentences.zh: 检测仅附加批次并在可能时直接更新最右边的路径。

blocks.html_en: • Groups mutations by target leaf.

sentences.en: Groups mutations by target leaf.
sentences.zh: 按目标叶对突变进行分组。

blocks.html_en: • Can prefetch leaves through Store::batch_get_ordered.

sentences.en: Can prefetch leaves through Store::batch_get_ordered.
sentences.zh: 可以通过 Store::batch_get_ordered 预取叶子。

blocks.html_en: • Applies grouped mutations with either a two-pointer merge or binary search.

sentences.en: Applies grouped mutations with either a two-pointer merge or binary search.
sentences.zh: 通过两指针合并或二分搜索应用分组突变。

blocks.html_en: • Rebuilds affected parents and flushes nodes atomically through store batch writes when supported.

sentences.en: Rebuilds affected parents and flushes nodes atomically through store batch writes when supported.
sentences.zh: 当支持时，重建受影响的父级并通过存储批量写入以原子方式刷新节点。

blocks.html_en: Use BatchWriter when a writer object is convenient. Its ParallelConfig controls only scheduling width and threshold; persisted policy and canonical output remain invariant.

sentences.en: Use BatchWriter when a writer object is convenient.
sentences.zh: 当编写器对象方便时使用 BatchWriter。

sentences.en: Its ParallelConfig controls only scheduling width and threshold; persisted policy and canonical output remain invariant.
sentences.zh: 其ParallelConfig仅控制调度宽度和阈值；持续的政策和规范的输出保持不变。

blocks.html_en: The reported effective width may be lower than the requested width when many large writers run concurrently. Once caller threads saturate the shared Rayon pool, inner parallel work is disabled to avoid oversubscription and tail-latency regressions. It may also remain one when the selected policy finds no proved-independent work; telemetry reports width actually used, not merely the requested or initially admitted width.

sentences.en: The reported effective width may be lower than the requested width when many large writers run concurrently.
sentences.zh: 当许多大型写入程序同时运行时，报告的有效宽度可能低于请求的宽度。

sentences.en: Once caller threads saturate the shared Rayon pool, inner parallel work is disabled to avoid oversubscription and tail-latency regressions.
sentences.zh: 一旦调用者线程使共享 Rayon 池饱和，内部并行工作将被禁用，以避免过度订阅和尾延迟回归。

sentences.en: It may also remain one when the selected policy finds no proved-independent work; telemetry reports width actually used, not merely the requested or initially admitted width.
sentences.zh: 当所选政策没有发现经过证明的独立工作时，它也可能保持为一；遥测报告实际使用的宽度，而不仅仅是请求的或最初承认的宽度。

blocks.html_en: Direct parallel leaf replacement is limited to non-growing value updates under key-only entry-count hashing. Value-sensitive and byte-measured policies use the canonical streaming writer even for rightmost leaves.

sentences.en: Direct parallel leaf replacement is limited to non-growing value updates under key-only entry-count hashing.
sentences.zh: 直接并行叶替换仅限于仅键条目计数哈希下的非增长值更新。

sentences.en: Value-sensitive and byte-measured policies use the canonical streaming writer even for rightmost leaves.
sentences.zh: 值敏感和字节测量策略即使对于最右边的叶子也使用规范的流编写器。

blocks.html_en: Bulk Building

sentences.en: Bulk Building
sentences.zh: 散装建筑

blocks.html_en: Use BatchBuilder when you have many unsorted entries and want to build a fresh tree:

sentences.en: Use BatchBuilder when you have many unsorted entries and want to build a fresh tree:
sentences.zh: 当您有许多未排序的条目并想要构建新的树时，请使用 BatchBuilder：

blocks.html_en: BatchBuilder sorts entries, computes hash-boundary predicates in parallel with Rayon, writes leaf nodes in batches, and then builds internal levels bottom-up.

sentences.en: BatchBuilder sorts entries, computes hash-boundary predicates in parallel with Rayon, writes leaf nodes in batches, and then builds internal levels bottom-up.
sentences.zh: BatchBuilder 对条目进行排序，与 Rayon 并行计算哈希边界谓词，批量写入叶节点，然后自下而上构建内部级别。

blocks.html_en: Use SortedBatchBuilder when the input is already sorted by key. It can stream leaf construction without retaining every key-value pair in memory.

sentences.en: Use SortedBatchBuilder when the input is already sorted by key.
sentences.zh: 当输入已按键排序时使用 SortedBatchBuilder。

sentences.en: It can stream leaf construction without retaining every key-value pair in memory.
sentences.zh: 它可以流式传输叶构造，而无需在内存中保留每个键值对。

blocks.html_en: Diff, Range Diff, and Merge

sentences.en: Diff, Range Diff, and Merge
sentences.zh: 差异、范围差异和合并

blocks.html_en: Diff APIs compare tree structure before falling back to leaf-level comparison:

sentences.en: Diff APIs compare tree structure before falling back to leaf-level comparison:
sentences.zh: Diff API 在回退到叶级比较之前比较树结构：

blocks.html_en: • diff(&base, &other) returns collected Diff entries.

sentences.en: diff(&base, &other) returns collected Diff entries.
sentences.zh: diff(&base, &other) 返回收集的 Diff 条目。

blocks.html_en: • range_diff(&base, &other, start, end) prunes subtrees outside a half-open key range.

sentences.en: range_diff(&base, &other, start, end) prunes subtrees outside a half-open key range.
sentences.zh: range_diff(&base, &other, start, end) 修剪半开键范围之外的子树。

blocks.html_en: • diff_from_cursor(&base, &other, cursor, end) resumes strictly after the cursor key.

sentences.en: diff_from_cursor(&base, &other, cursor, end) resumes strictly after the cursor key.
sentences.zh: diff_from_cursor（&base，&other，cursor，end）严格在光标键之后恢复。

blocks.html_en: • diff_page(&base, &other, cursor, end, limit) reads bounded diff pages for checkpointed indexing and sync jobs.

sentences.en: diff_page(&base, &other, cursor, end, limit) reads bounded diff pages for checkpointed indexing and sync jobs.
sentences.zh: diff_page(&base, &other,cursor,end,limit) 读取有界差异页面以进行检查点索引和同步作业。

blocks.html_en: • prove_diff_page(&base, &other, cursor, end, limit) returns the same diff page plus a store-independent proof over both roots and any continuation lookahead needed to verify pagination.

sentences.en: prove_diff_page(&base, &other, cursor, end, limit) returns the same diff page plus a store-independent proof over both roots and any continuation lookahead needed to verify pagination.
sentences.zh: Prove_diff_page(&base, &other,cursor,end,limit) 返回相同的 diff 页面，加上两个根上的独立于存储的证明以及验证分页所需的任何连续前瞻。

blocks.html_en: • structural_diff_page(&base, &other, cursor, limit) checkpoints the actual CID frontier so large diff jobs can resume without recomputing from a key.

sentences.en: structural_diff_page(&base, &other, cursor, limit) checkpoints the actual CID frontier so large diff jobs can resume without recomputing from a key.
sentences.zh: Structured_diff_page(&base, &other, Cursor, limit) 检查实际 CID 边界，以便大型 diff 作业可以恢复，而无需从键重新计算。

blocks.html_en: • diff_cursor(&base, &other) and stream_diff(&base, &other) stream changes.

sentences.en: diff_cursor(&base, &other) and stream_diff(&base, &other) stream changes.
sentences.zh: diff_cursor(&base, &other) 和stream_diff(&base, &other) 流更改。

blocks.html_en: • stream_conflicts(&base, &left, &right) streams only three-way merge conflicts without materializing the full right-side diff.

sentences.en: stream_conflicts(&base, &left, &right) streams only three-way merge conflicts without materializing the full right-side diff.
sentences.zh: Stream_conflicts(&base, &left, &right) 仅流式传输三向合并冲突，而不实现完整的右侧差异。

blocks.html_en: Fast paths:

sentences.en: Fast paths:
sentences.zh: 快速路径：

blocks.html_en: • Same root CID returns no changes in O(1).

sentences.en: Same root CID returns no changes in O(1).
sentences.zh: 相同的根 CID 在 O(1) 时间内不返回任何变化。

blocks.html_en: • Equal child CIDs skip whole subtrees.

sentences.en: Equal child CIDs skip whole subtrees.
sentences.zh: 相等的子 CID 会跳过整个子树。

blocks.html_en: • Matching child spans recurse structurally.

sentences.en: Matching child spans recurse structurally.
sentences.zh: 匹配子跨度在结构上递归。

blocks.html_en: • Divergent boundaries fall back to ordered collection and comparison for the affected subtree.

sentences.en: Divergent boundaries fall back to ordered collection and comparison for the affected subtree.
sentences.zh: 发散边界回退到受影响子树的有序收集和比较。

blocks.html_en: For background sync or indexing jobs that want to preserve subtree pruning between checkpoints, page the structural traversal directly:

sentences.en: For background sync or indexing jobs that want to preserve subtree pruning between checkpoints, page the structural traversal directly:
sentences.zh: 对于想要保留检查点之间的子树修剪的后台同步或索引作业，请直接分页结构遍历：

blocks.html_en: merge(&base, &left, &right, resolver) performs a three-way merge. It detects conflicts when both sides change the same key differently. A resolver returns Resolution::Value, Resolution::Delete, or Resolution::Unresolved; unresolved conflicts return Error::Conflict.

sentences.en: merge(&base, &left, &right, resolver) performs a three-way merge.
sentences.zh: merge(&base, &left, &right, resolver) 执行三向合并。

sentences.en: It detects conflicts when both sides change the same key differently.
sentences.zh: 当双方以不同方式更改同一密钥时，它会检测到冲突。

sentences.en: A resolver returns Resolution::Value, Resolution::Delete, or Resolution::Unresolved; unresolved conflicts return Error::Conflict.
sentences.zh: 解析器返回Resolution::Value、Resolution::Delete或Resolution::Unresolved；未解决的冲突返回 Error::Conflict。

blocks.html_en: Use merge_range(&base, &left, &right, start, end, resolver) when only one keyspace should accept right-side changes. merge_prefix is the convenience form for prefix-partitioned data such as one document, tenant, workspace, or secondary index shard:

sentences.en: Use merge_range(&base, &left, &right, start, end, resolver) when only one keyspace should accept right-side changes.
sentences.zh: 当只有一个键空间应该接受右侧更改时，请使用 merge_range(&base, &left, &right, start, end, resolver) 。

sentences.en: merge_prefix is the convenience form for prefix-partitioned data such as one document, tenant, workspace, or secondary index shard:
sentences.zh: merge_prefix 是前缀分区数据（例如一个文档、租户、工作区或二级索引分片）的一种便捷形式：

blocks.html_en: Use merge_explain when merge behavior needs to be observable. It returns a MergeExplanation with both the merge result and a typed trace. The trace is kept even when the merge result is Error::Conflict, so applications can show custom resolver calls, fallback reasons, reused subtrees, and rewritten node spans in debugging UIs or sync logs. When merge falls back to the diff/batch path, the trace includes DiffTraversal counters such as compared nodes, skipped equal subtrees, collected subtree fallbacks, and emitted diff entries.

sentences.en: Use merge_explain when merge behavior needs to be observable.
sentences.zh: 当合并行为需要可观察时使用 merge_explain。

sentences.en: It returns a MergeExplanation with both the merge result and a typed trace.
sentences.zh: 它返回一个包含合并结果和类型化跟踪的 MergeExplanation。

sentences.en: The trace is kept even when the merge result is Error::Conflict, so applications can show custom resolver calls, fallback reasons, reused subtrees, and rewritten node spans in debugging UIs or sync logs.
sentences.zh: 即使合并结果为 Error::Conflict，跟踪也会保留，因此应用程序可以在调试 UI 或同步日志中显示自定义解析器调用、回退原因、重用的子树以及重写的节点范围。

sentences.en: When merge falls back to the diff/batch path, the trace includes DiffTraversal counters such as compared nodes, skipped equal subtrees, collected subtree fallbacks, and emitted diff entries.
sentences.zh: 当合并回退到 diff/batch 路径时，跟踪包括 DiffTraversal 计数器，例如比较节点、跳过的相等子树、收集的子树回退和发出的 diff 条目。

blocks.html_en: The same explanation shape is available as AsyncProlly::merge_explain under the async-store feature, which lets remote sync jobs and object-store-backed applications keep resolver diagnostics without blocking on sync storage APIs.

sentences.en: The same explanation shape is available as AsyncProlly::merge_explain under the async-store feature, which lets remote sync jobs and object-store-backed applications keep resolver diagnostics without blocking on sync storage APIs.
sentences.zh: 异步存储功能下的 AsyncProlly::merge_explain 提供相同的解释形状，它允许远程同步作业和对象存储支持的应用程序保持解析器诊断，而不会阻塞同步存储 API。

blocks.html_en: Use stream_conflicts when an application needs to ask a user, agent, or domain policy about conflicts before choosing a resolver. The iterator yields delete-aware Conflict values and skips clean right-side changes:

sentences.en: Use stream_conflicts when an application needs to ask a user, agent, or domain policy about conflicts before choosing a resolver.
sentences.zh: 当应用程序需要在选择解析器之前询问用户、代理或域策略有关冲突的信息时，请使用stream_conflicts。

sentences.en: The iterator yields delete-aware Conflict values and skips clean right-side changes:
sentences.zh: 迭代器产生删除感知的冲突值并跳过干净的右侧更改：

blocks.html_en: AsyncProlly::stream_conflicts exposes the same delete-aware conflict stream under the async-store feature with next().await, collect().await, and into_stream() adapters.

sentences.en: AsyncProlly::stream_conflicts exposes the same delete-aware conflict stream under the async-store feature with next().await, collect().await, and into_stream() adapters.
sentences.zh: AsyncProlly::stream_conflicts 在异步存储功能下使用 next().await、collect().await 和 into_stream() 适配器公开相同的删除感知冲突流。

blocks.html_en: For applications with domain-specific rules, use MergePolicyRegistry to compose resolvers by key prefix, exact key, or custom matcher. Later matching rules override earlier ones:

sentences.en: For applications with domain-specific rules, use MergePolicyRegistry to compose resolvers by key prefix, exact key, or custom matcher.
sentences.zh: 对于具有特定于域的规则的应用程序，请使用 MergePolicyRegistry 按键前缀、精确键或自定义匹配器组成解析器。

blocks.html_en: Named roots are mutable pointers to immutable tree handles. Calling put, delete, batch, or merge never advances a named root by itself. Those operations return a new Tree; the application must publish that tree with publish_named_root or, for concurrent writers, compare_and_swap_named_root. This is similar to creating a new Git tree object and then updating a ref to point at it.

blocks.html_en: compare_and_swap_named_root lets concurrent writers update a named root only when the current tree matches the expected tree. publish_named_root replaces a name unconditionally, and delete_named_root removes the name without removing content-addressed nodes. MemStore supports this for tests and lightweight use. The SQLite and PGlite adapters store roots in a dedicated table. RocksDBStore stores roots in a dedicated column family. SlateDbStore stores roots under a dedicated key prefix. Durable stores keep named-root data separate from content-addressed node bytes.

sentences.en: SlateDbStore stores roots under a dedicated key prefix.
sentences.zh: SlateDbStore 将根存储在专用的键前缀下。

sentences.en: Durable stores keep named-root data separate from content-addressed node bytes.
sentences.zh: 持久存储将命名根数据与内容寻址节点字节分开。

blocks.html_en: Stores that can enumerate manifests implement ManifestStoreScan. Use list_named_roots, load_named_roots, and load_retained_named_roots to build explicit retained-root sets for background jobs and garbage collection. NamedRootRetention supports retaining all roots, exact root names, a name prefix, the lexicographically newest N roots under a prefix, or roots updated since a Unix-millisecond timestamp. Manager-level publish and CAS helpers stamp created_at_millis and updated_at_millis; *_at_millis variants accept explicit timestamps for deterministic import and tests.

blocks.html_en: Transactions and MVCC

sentences.en: Transactions and MVCC
sentences.zh: 交易和 MVCC

blocks.html_en: Tree handles are immutable MVCC snapshots: readers that hold an old Tree keep seeing that version while writers build a new one. Strict transactions add a staging layer around those immutable writes. A transaction buffers new content-addressed nodes and named-root writes in memory, validates every named root it read, then asks the store to commit staged nodes and roots atomically. If the closure returns an error, validation fails, or the backend commit fails, the staged overlay is discarded and no partial root update is made visible.

sentences.en: Tree handles are immutable MVCC snapshots: readers that hold an old Tree keep seeing that version while writers build a new one.
sentences.zh: 树句柄是不可变的 MVCC 快照：持有旧树的读者会继续看到该版本，而作者会构建新的版本。

sentences.en: Strict transactions add a staging layer around those immutable writes.
sentences.zh: 严格的事务在这些不可变的写入周围添加了一个暂存层。

sentences.en: A transaction buffers new content-addressed nodes and named-root writes in memory, validates every named root it read, then asks the store to commit staged nodes and roots atomically.
sentences.zh: 事务在内存中缓冲新的内容寻址节点和命名根写入，验证它读取的每个命​​名根，然后要求存储以原子方式提交暂存节点和根。

sentences.en: If the closure returns an error, validation fails, or the backend commit fails, the staged overlay is discarded and no partial root update is made visible.
sentences.zh: 如果闭包返回错误、验证失败或后端提交失败，则分阶段覆盖将被丢弃，并且部分根更新不可见。

blocks.html_en: For materialized views and secondary indexes, prefer one authoritative commit root such as tickets/current that points to an application manifest containing the source and index snapshots. Readers load that one root and get a consistent pair. Writers build candidate source/index trees in a transaction and publish only the commit root. Multiple named roots can be updated in one transaction, but a single commit root keeps reader coordination simple.

sentences.zh: 对于物化视图和二级索引，首选一个权威提交根，例如 Tickets/current ，它指向包含源快照和索引快照的应用程序清单。

sentences.zh: 编写者在事务中构建候选源/索引树并仅发布提交根。

sentences.en: Multiple named roots can be updated in one transaction, but a single commit root keeps reader coordination simple.
sentences.zh: 可以在一个事务中更新多个命名根，但单个提交根使读取器协调变得简单。

blocks.html_en: Large Value Offloading

sentences.en: Large Value Offloading
sentences.zh: 大额卸载

blocks.html_en: Large payloads can be kept out of leaf nodes by using the large-value helper layer. Small values remain raw inline leaf bytes. Values larger than the configured threshold are written to a content-addressed BlobStore, and the tree stores a compact ValueRef::Blob envelope containing the blob CID and length.

sentences.en: Large payloads can be kept out of leaf nodes by using the large-value helper layer.
sentences.zh: 通过使用大值辅助层，可以将大负载排除在叶节点之外。

sentences.en: Small values remain raw inline leaf bytes.
sentences.zh: 小值保留原始内联叶字节。

sentences.en: Values larger than the configured threshold are written to a content-addressed BlobStore, and the tree stores a compact ValueRef::Blob envelope containing the blob CID and length.
sentences.zh: 大于配置阈值的值将写入内容寻址的 BlobStore，并且树存储包含 blob CID 和长度的紧凑 ValueRef::Blob 信封。

blocks.html_en: put_large_value writes blob bytes before publishing the tree update. Repeated large writes are content-addressed and deduplicate in MemBlobStore. get_large_value also reads ordinary raw values, so applications can migrate to offloading gradually. Calling plain get on an offloaded value returns the stored reference envelope, not the resolved blob bytes.

sentences.en: put_large_value writes blob bytes before publishing the tree update.
sentences.zh: put_large_value 在发布树更新之前写入 blob 字节。

sentences.en: Repeated large writes are content-addressed and deduplicate in MemBlobStore.
sentences.zh: 重复的大型写入在 MemBlobStore 中进行内容寻址和重复数据删除。

sentences.en: get_large_value also reads ordinary raw values, so applications can migrate to offloading gradually.
sentences.zh: get_large_value 还读取普通原始值，因此应用程序可以逐渐迁移到卸载。

sentences.en: Calling plain get on an offloaded value returns the stored reference envelope, not the resolved blob bytes.
sentences.zh: 对卸载值调用普通 get 返回存储的引用信封，而不是解析的 blob 字节。

blocks.html_en: Use FileBlobStore when local durable blob storage is enough. It stores blobs under blobs/sha256/aa/bb/<cid-hex>, validates blob bytes on read, and implements BlobStoreScan so GC can use backend listing as its candidate set:

sentences.en: Use FileBlobStore when local durable blob storage is enough.
sentences.zh: 当本地持久 Blob 存储足够时，使用 FileBlobStore。

sentences.en: It stores blobs under blobs/sha256/aa/bb/<cid-hex>, validates blob bytes on read, and implements BlobStoreScan so GC can use backend listing as its candidate set:
sentences.zh: 它将 blob 存储在 blobs/sha256/aa/bb/<cid-hex> 下，在读取时验证 blob 字节，并实现 BlobStoreScan，以便 GC 可以使用后端列表作为其候选集：

blocks.html_en: Offloaded blobs have their own candidate-driven GC helpers. This mirrors node GC: mark reachable blob references from retained trees, dry-run against a candidate set, then sweep exactly the unreachable candidates. Continuing with an existing prolly, blobs, and policy:

sentences.en: Offloaded blobs have their own candidate-driven GC helpers.
sentences.zh: 卸载的 blob 有自己的候选驱动的 GC 助手。

sentences.en: This mirrors node GC: mark reachable blob references from retained trees, dry-run against a candidate set, then sweep exactly the unreachable candidates.
sentences.zh: 这反映了节点 GC：从保留的树中标记可到达的 blob 引用，针对候选集进行空运行，然后精确扫描无法到达的候选者。

sentences.en: Continuing with an existing prolly, blobs, and policy:
sentences.zh: 继续使用现有的 prolly、blob 和策略：

blocks.html_en: Garbage Collection

sentences.en: Garbage Collection
sentences.zh: 垃圾收集

blocks.html_en: Immutable updates preserve old tree nodes, so long-lived applications should eventually reclaim nodes that are no longer reachable from retained roots. The generic GC API accepts explicit candidate CIDs, and built-in stores that can scan their node namespace also implement NodeStoreScan for store-wide planning.

sentences.en: Immutable updates preserve old tree nodes, so long-lived applications should eventually reclaim nodes that are no longer reachable from retained roots.
sentences.zh: 不可变的更新会保留旧的树节点，因此长期存在的应用程序最终应该回收无法从保留的根访问的节点。

sentences.en: The generic GC API accepts explicit candidate CIDs, and built-in stores that can scan their node namespace also implement NodeStoreScan for store-wide planning.
sentences.zh: 通用 GC API 接受显式候选 CID，并且可以扫描其节点命名空间的内置存储还实现 NodeStoreScan 以进行存储范围的规划。

blocks.html_en: mark_reachable deduplicates shared subtrees across roots. plan_gc is a dry-run: it reports unreachable candidate CIDs that are present in the store, their reclaimable byte count, and candidate CIDs that were already missing. sweep_gc deletes exactly the reclaimable candidates from the plan and clears the manager cache afterward so swept nodes are not served from memory.

sentences.en: mark_reachable deduplicates shared subtrees across roots.
sentences.zh: mark_reachable 跨根删除共享子树的重复数据。

sentences.en: plan_gc is a dry-run: it reports unreachable candidate CIDs that are present in the store, their reclaimable byte count, and candidate CIDs that were already missing.
sentences.zh: plan_gc 是一个空运行：它报告存储中存在的无法访问的候选 CID、它们的可回收字节计数以及已经丢失的候选 CID。

sentences.en: sweep_gc deletes exactly the reclaimable candidates from the plan and clears the manager cache afterward so swept nodes are not served from memory.
sentences.zh: scan_gc 从计划中准确删除可回收的候选者，并随后清除管理器缓存，因此不会从内存中提供扫描节点。

blocks.html_en: When the backing store implements NodeStoreScan, use plan_store_gc and sweep_store_gc to scan all stored node CIDs automatically:

sentences.en: When the backing store implements NodeStoreScan, use plan_store_gc and sweep_store_gc to scan all stored node CIDs automatically:
sentences.zh: 当后备存储实现NodeStoreScan时，使用plan_store_gc和sweep_store_gc自动扫描所有存储的节点CID：

blocks.html_en: For named-root applications, use retention policies so GC keeps the branch, checkpoint, workspace, and sync-cursor roots that should survive:

sentences.en: For named-root applications, use retention policies so GC keeps the branch, checkpoint, workspace, and sync-cursor roots that should survive:
sentences.zh: 对于命名根应用程序，使用保留策略，以便 GC 保留应该存活的分支、检查点、工作区和同步游标根：

blocks.html_en: Exact-name retention reports missing names, and the GC convenience helpers fail with Error::MissingNamedRoots when exact roots are absent. Prefix and newest-by-name policies intentionally select from roots that currently exist. Use NamedRootRetention::updated_since(prefix, cutoff_millis) or the duration-style updated_within* helpers for time-window retention when manifests have updated_at_millis metadata:

sentences.en: Exact-name retention reports missing names, and the GC convenience helpers fail with Error::MissingNamedRoots when exact roots are absent.
sentences.zh: 精确名称保留报告缺少名称，并且当精确根不存在时，GC 便利帮助程序会失败并显示 Error::MissingNamedRoots。

sentences.en: Prefix and newest-by-name policies intentionally select from roots that currently exist.
sentences.zh: 前缀和最新名称策略有意从当前存在的根中进行选择。

sentences.en: Use NamedRootRetention::updated_since(prefix, cutoff_millis) or the duration-style updated_within* helpers for time-window retention when manifests have updated_at_millis metadata:
sentences.zh: 当清单具有 update_at_millis 元数据时，使用 NamedRootRetention::updated_since(prefix, cutoff_millis) 或持续时间样式的 Updated_within* 帮助程序进行时间窗口保留：

blocks.html_en: Passing an incomplete retained-root set can delete nodes that another branch or checkpoint still needs.

sentences.en: Passing an incomplete retained-root set can delete nodes that another branch or checkpoint still needs.
sentences.zh: 传递不完整的保留根集可以删除另一个分支或检查点仍然需要的节点。

blocks.html_en: Snapshot Namespaces

sentences.en: Snapshot Namespaces
sentences.zh: 快照命名空间

blocks.html_en: Named roots are intentionally byte-level so applications can choose their own root scheme. Snapshot namespaces add a small convention layer for common branch, tag, checkpoint, and custom root names while reusing the same manifest storage, CAS updates, retention policies, and GC behavior.

sentences.en: Named roots are intentionally byte-level so applications can choose their own root scheme.
sentences.zh: 命名根有意为字节级，因此应用程序可以选择自己的根方案。

sentences.en: Snapshot namespaces add a small convention layer for common branch, tag, checkpoint, and custom root names while reusing the same manifest storage, CAS updates, retention policies, and GC behavior.
sentences.zh: 快照命名空间为公共分支、标记、检查点和自定义根名称添加了一个小型约定层，同时重用相同的清单存储、CAS 更新、保留策略和 GC 行为。

blocks.html_en: Built-in Versioned Map

sentences.en: Built-in Versioned Map
sentences.zh: 内置版本化地图

blocks.html_en: Use VersionedMap when an application wants a durable map with linear history but does not need a full Git-like repository model. The facade removes manual tree and named-root coordination from the common path:

sentences.en: Use VersionedMap when an application wants a durable map with linear history but does not need a full Git-like repository model.
sentences.zh: 当应用程序需要具有线性历史记录的持久映射但不需要完整的类似 Git 的存储库模型时，请使用 VersionedMap。

sentences.en: The facade removes manual tree and named-root coordination from the common path:
sentences.zh: 外观从公共路径中删除了手动树和命名根协调：

blocks.html_en: The managed-map API also exposes snapshot-consistent bulk reads and cursor pages. Pin pages to a version when a request sequence must not move with head:

sentences.en: The managed-map API also exposes snapshot-consistent bulk reads and cursor pages.
sentences.zh: 托管映射 API 还公开快照一致的批量读取和游标页面。

sentences.en: Pin pages to a version when a request sequence must not move with head:
sentences.zh: 当请求序列不得随头部移动时，将页面固定到某个版本：

blocks.html_en: Use conditional helpers for request-level optimistic concurrency:

sentences.en: Use conditional helpers for request-level optimistic concurrency:
sentences.zh: 使用条件助手实现请求级乐观并发：

blocks.html_en: Pin a MapSnapshot at the beginning of a request when every read and proof must use one immutable root, even if another writer advances the map head:

sentences.en: Pin a MapSnapshot at the beginning of a request when every read and proof must use one immutable root, even if another writer advances the map head:
sentences.zh: 当每次读取和证明都必须使用一个不可变的根时，即使另一位写入者推进了映射头，也将 MapSnapshot 固定在请求的开头：

blocks.html_en: The same pinned model supports comparisons and collaboration. compare gives repeatable diff streams, cursor pages, proofs, statistics, and changed-span hints. prepare_merge pins base, current head, and candidate, then publishes with CAS using strict, policy-registry, or CRDT conflict handling.

sentences.en: The same pinned model supports comparisons and collaboration.
sentences.zh: 相同的固定模型支持比较和协作。

sentences.en: compare gives repeatable diff streams, cursor pages, proofs, statistics, and changed-span hints.
sentences.zh: 比较提供可重复的差异流、光标页面、校样、统计数据和更改范围提示。

sentences.en: prepare_merge pins base, current head, and candidate, then publishes with CAS using strict, policy-registry, or CRDT conflict handling.
sentences.zh: prepare_merge 固定基础、当前头部和候选，然后使用严格的策略注册或 CRDT 冲突处理通过 CAS 进行发布。

blocks.html_en: Operational workflows stay on the managed-map handle:

sentences.en: Operational workflows stay on the managed-map handle:
sentences.zh: 操作工作流程保留在托管地图句柄上：

blocks.html_en: • backup/restore_backup, snapshot export/import, missing-node copy, and push_to provide portable verification and store-to-store transfer.

sentences.en: backup/restore_backup, snapshot export/import, missing-node copy, and push_to provide portable verification and store-to-store transfer.
sentences.zh: backup/restore_backup、快照导出/导入、缺失节点复制和push_to提供可移植验证和存储到存储传输。

blocks.html_en: • put_large_value and get_large_value use configured blob offload; plan_blob_gc and sweep_blob_gc remain scoped to retained map versions.

sentences.en: put_large_value and get_large_value use configured blob offload; plan_blob_gc and sweep_blob_gc remain scoped to retained map versions.
sentences.zh: put_large_value 和 get_large_value 使用配置的 blob 卸载； plan_blob_gc和sweep_blob_gc的范围仍然是保留的地图版本。

blocks.html_en: • initialize_sorted, append, parallel_apply, and rebuild_sorted_if cover first load, append-heavy ingestion, parallel mutation, and atomic replacement.

sentences.en: initialize_sorted, append, parallel_apply, and rebuild_sorted_if cover first load, append-heavy ingestion, parallel mutation, and atomic replacement.
sentences.zh: initialize_sorted、append、parallel_apply 和rebuild_sorted_if 涵盖首次加载、追加大量摄取、并行突变和原子替换。

blocks.html_en: • verify_catalog, keep_last, keep_for, and keep_versions make catalog maintenance map-scoped; plan_gc/sweep_gc safely retain every other named root because content-addressed node and blob stores may be shared.

sentences.en: verify_catalog, keep_last, keep_for, and keep_versions make catalog maintenance map-scoped; plan_gc/sweep_gc safely retain every other named root because content-addressed node and blob stores may be shared.
sentences.zh: verify_catalog、keep_last、keep_for 和 keep_versions 使目录维护在地图范围内； plan_gc/sweep_gc 安全地保留所有其他命名根，因为内容寻址节点和 blob 存储可以共享。

blocks.html_en: • versioned_maps_transaction atomically changes authoritative maps, derived database indexes, and materialized views together.

sentences.en: versioned_maps_transaction atomically changes authoritative maps, derived database indexes, and materialized views together.
sentences.zh: versioned_maps_transaction 以原子方式一起更改权威映射、派生数据库索引和物化视图。

blocks.html_en: Apps can remove most serialization boilerplate with typed::<K,V,KC,VC>. StringKeyCodec or an application-defined order-preserving KeyCodec owns key encoding; VersionedJsonCodec and VersionedCborCodec validate the value schema and version. migrate_from decodes one pinned old version, rewrites its values, and CAS-publishes only if it is still head. subscribe and subscribe_from emit resumable head transitions with logical diffs. With the async-store feature, AsyncVersionedMap, pinned async snapshots, and async subscriptions provide the corresponding remote/browser path.

sentences.en: Apps can remove most serialization boilerplate with typed::<K,V,KC,VC>.
sentences.zh: 应用程序可以使用类型为::<K,V,KC,VC> 删除大多数序列化样板。

sentences.en: StringKeyCodec or an application-defined order-preserving KeyCodec owns key encoding; VersionedJsonCodec and VersionedCborCodec validate the value schema and version.
sentences.zh: StringKeyCodec 或应用程序定义的保序 KeyCodec 拥有密钥编码； VersionedJsonCodec 和 VersionedCborCodec 验证值架构和版本。

sentences.en: migrate_from decodes one pinned old version, rewrites its values, and CAS-publishes only if it is still head.
sentences.zh: migrate_from 解码一个固定的旧版本，重写其值，并且仅当它仍然是头时才进行 CAS 发布。

sentences.en: subscribe and subscribe_from emit resumable head transitions with logical diffs.
sentences.zh: subscribe 和 subscribe_from 发出具有逻辑差异的可恢复头转换。

sentences.en: With the async-store feature, AsyncVersionedMap, pinned async snapshots, and async subscriptions provide the corresponding remote/browser path.
sentences.zh: 通过异步存储功能，AsyncVersionedMap、固定异步快照和异步订阅提供相应的远程/浏览器路径。

blocks.html_en: The engine atomically writes new nodes, advances the head, and catalogs the version through TransactionalStore. Convenience writes retry optimistic conflicts; use apply_if when the application must reject a stale caller. Map version IDs identify unique tree states, not update events. Authors, messages, parent commits, branches, and reflogs remain concerns of the proposed prolly-vcs repository layer.

sentences.en: The engine atomically writes new nodes, advances the head, and catalogs the version through TransactionalStore.
sentences.zh: 引擎自动写入新节点，推进头部，并通过 TransactionalStore 对版本进行编目。

sentences.en: Convenience writes retry optimistic conflicts; use apply_if when the application must reject a stale caller.
sentences.zh: 方便写入重试乐观冲突；当应用程序必须拒绝过时的调用者时，请使用 apply_if。

sentences.en: Map version IDs identify unique tree states, not update events.
sentences.zh: 地图版本 ID 标识唯一的树状态，而不是更新事件。

sentences.en: Authors, messages, parent commits, branches, and reflogs remain concerns of the proposed prolly-vcs repository layer.
sentences.zh: 作者、消息、父提交、分支和引用日志仍然是提议的 prolly-vcs 存储库层的关注点。

blocks.html_en: The retention policy identifies this map's complete catalog when composing a custom store-level policy:

sentences.en: The retention policy identifies this map's complete catalog when composing a custom store-level policy:
sentences.zh: 在编写自定义商店级策略时，保留策略会标识此地图的完整目录：

blocks.html_en: Catalog growth is explicit. prune_versions(n) retains the newest n snapshots and always retains the current head, including an older rolled-back head. It removes version roots transactionally; run retention-aware GC afterward to reclaim unreachable nodes:

sentences.en: Catalog growth is explicit.
sentences.zh: 目录增长是明确的。

sentences.en: prune_versions(n) retains the newest n snapshots and always retains the current head, including an older rolled-back head.
sentences.zh: prune_versions(n) 保留最新的 n 个快照，并始终保留当前的头，包括较旧的回滚头。

sentences.en: It removes version roots transactionally; run retention-aware GC afterward to reclaim unreachable nodes:
sentences.zh: 它以事务方式删除版本根；之后运行保留感知GC来回收无法访问的节点：

blocks.html_en: sweep_gc retains every remaining named root in the shared store. Do not pass one map's prefix directly to a store-wide sweep when other maps share that store.

sentences.en: sweep_gc retains every remaining named root in the shared store.
sentences.zh: scrap_gc 保留共享存储中所有剩余的命名根。

sentences.en: Do not pass one map's prefix directly to a store-wide sweep when other maps share that store.
sentences.zh: 当其他地图共享该商店时，请勿将一张地图的前缀直接传递给商店范围的扫描。

blocks.html_en: Here, “map” is the authoritative ordered key/value collection. A database-style index remains a separate, derived map—for example email -> user_id—usually maintained from source-map diffs or in the same strict multi-map transaction. VersionedMap is therefore a lifecycle facade over a prolly tree, not a claim that every managed map is a database index. See secondary_index.rs for that distinct pattern.

sentences.en: Here, “map” is the authoritative ordered key/value collection.
sentences.zh: 这里，“map”是权威的有序键/值集合。

sentences.en: A database-style index remains a separate, derived map—for example email -> user_id—usually maintained from source-map diffs or in the same strict multi-map transaction.
sentences.zh: 数据库样式索引仍然是一个单独的派生映射（例如电子邮件 -> user_id），通常通过源映射差异或在同一严格的多映射事务中进行维护。

sentences.en: VersionedMap is therefore a lifecycle facade over a prolly tree, not a claim that every managed map is a database index.
sentences.zh: 因此，VersionedMap 是 Prolly 树上的生命周期外观，而不是声称每个托管映射都是数据库索引。

sentences.en: See secondary_index.rs for that distinct pattern.
sentences.zh: 请参阅 secondary_index.rs 了解该独特模式。

blocks.html_en: Store Synchronization

sentences.en: Store Synchronization
sentences.zh: 商店同步

blocks.html_en: Use missing-node planning to copy a tree root between stores without rewriting nodes the destination already has. This is the low-level Merkle sync primitive for remote peers, object-store caches, workspace sync, and background agents.

sentences.en: Use missing-node planning to copy a tree root between stores without rewriting nodes the destination already has.
sentences.zh: 使用缺失节点规划在存储之间复制树根，而无需重写目标已有的节点。

sentences.en: This is the low-level Merkle sync primitive for remote peers, object-store caches, workspace sync, and background agents.
sentences.zh: 这是用于远程对等点、对象存储缓存、工作区同步和后台代理的低级 Merkle 同步原语。

blocks.html_en: plan_missing_nodes walks the source tree, checks the destination with ordered batch reads, and verifies any destination bytes against their CID. Missing source bytes are also re-hashed before they are counted or copied. If a store returns bytes that do not match the requested CID, the operation fails with Error::CidMismatch instead of trusting corrupted content.

sentences.en: plan_missing_nodes walks the source tree, checks the destination with ordered batch reads, and verifies any destination bytes against their CID.
sentences.zh: plan_missing_nodes 遍历源树，通过有序批量读取检查目标，并根据其 CID 验证任何目标字节。

sentences.en: Missing source bytes are also re-hashed before they are counted or copied.
sentences.zh: 丢失的源字节在被计数或复制之前也会被重新散列。

sentences.en: If a store returns bytes that do not match the requested CID, the operation fails with Error::CidMismatch instead of trusting corrupted content.
sentences.zh: 如果存储返回与请求的 CID 不匹配的字节，则操作将失败并显示 Error::CidMismatch，而不是信任损坏的内容。

blocks.html_en: For a local object-layout backend, use FileNodeStore. It mirrors the namespace split a remote object-store adapter should use: immutable node objects live under nodes/sha256/..., optional hints under hints/..., and named roots under roots/....

sentences.en: For a local object-layout backend, use FileNodeStore.
sentences.zh: 对于本地对象布局后端，请使用 FileNodeStore。

sentences.en: It mirrors the namespace split a remote object-store adapter should use: immutable node objects live under nodes/sha256/..., optional hints under hints/..., and named roots under roots/....
sentences.zh: 它镜像了远程对象存储适配器应使用的命名空间分割：不可变节点对象位于nodes/sha256/...下，可选提示位于hints/...下，命名根位于roots/...下。

blocks.html_en: Async Store Support

sentences.en: Async Store Support
sentences.zh: 异步存储支持

blocks.html_en: Async storage is foundational and requires no Cargo feature. The async API is the canonical engine calling convention for remote, browser, object-store, and background-agent storage. Embedded synchronous users retain a zero-runtime path through the same engine.

sentences.en: Async storage is foundational and requires no Cargo feature.
sentences.zh: 异步存储是基础，不需要 Cargo 功能。

sentences.en: The async API is the canonical engine calling convention for remote, browser, object-store, and background-agent storage.
sentences.zh: 异步 API 是远程、浏览器、对象存储和后台代理存储的规范引擎调用约定。

sentences.en: Embedded synchronous users retain a zero-runtime path through the same engine.
sentences.zh: 嵌入式同步用户通过同一引擎保留零运行时路径。

blocks.html_en: AsyncStore default ordered batch reads deduplicate repeated keys, preserve result slots, and can overlap point reads up to read_parallelism(). Stores with native multi-get can override batch_get_ordered directly. Broad async tree traversals chunk child-frontier prefetches so stats, reachability, diff, range, batch routing, and missing-node sync do not hand one unbounded multi-get to remote or object-store-style backends.

sentences.en: AsyncStore default ordered batch reads deduplicate repeated keys, preserve result slots, and can overlap point reads up to read_parallelism().
sentences.zh: AsyncStore 默认有序批量读取会删除重复键、保留结果槽，并且可以重叠点读取直至 read_parallelism()。

sentences.en: Stores with native multi-get can override batch_get_ordered directly.
sentences.zh: 具有本机多重获取的商店可以直接覆盖batch_get_ordered。

sentences.en: Broad async tree traversals chunk child-frontier prefetches so stats, reachability, diff, range, batch routing, and missing-node sync do not hand one unbounded multi-get to remote or object-store-style backends.
sentences.zh: 广泛的异步树遍历块子边界预取，因此统计数据、可达性、差异、范围、批量路由和缺失节点同步不会将一个无限的多重获取传递给远程或对象存储样式的后端。

blocks.html_en: Large-value offloading also has async-native blob support. AsyncBlobStore mirrors BlobStore, SyncBlobStoreAsAsync adapts embedded blob stores without a runtime dependency, and AsyncProlly can put_large_value, get_large_value, mark_reachable_blobs, plan_blob_gc, and sweep_blob_gc through async blob backends:

sentences.en: Large-value offloading also has async-native blob support.
sentences.zh: 大值卸载还具有异步本机 blob 支持。

sentences.en: AsyncBlobStore mirrors BlobStore, SyncBlobStoreAsAsync adapts embedded blob stores without a runtime dependency, and AsyncProlly can put_large_value, get_large_value, mark_reachable_blobs, plan_blob_gc, and sweep_blob_gc through async blob backends:
sentences.zh: AsyncBlobStore 镜像 BlobStore，SyncBlobStoreAsAsync 适应嵌入式 blob 存储而无需运行时依赖，AsyncProlly 可以通过异步 blob 后端 put_large_value、get_large_value、mark_reachable_blobs、plan_blob_gc 和 swing_blob_gc：

sentences.zh: 读取和写入：创建、获取、get_many、放置、删除和批处理

sentences.zh: 扫描：范围迭代、range_after、range_from_cursor、range_page和reverse_page

sentences.en: Diffs: eager diff, range_diff, streaming diff, and conflict streaming

sentences.zh: 操作：统计信息、调试视图、可达性、缺失节点同步、缓存统计信息、缓存固定和缓存清除

blocks.html_en: Async batch routes sorted mutation ranges through ordered async node loads. It applies each touched leaf once, rebuilds only touched ancestors, and flushes rewritten nodes once.

sentences.en: Async batch routes sorted mutation ranges through ordered async node loads.
sentences.zh: 异步批处理通过有序异步节点加载路由排序的突变范围。

sentences.en: It applies each touched leaf once, rebuilds only touched ancestors, and flushes rewritten nodes once.
sentences.zh: 它应用每个触及的叶子一次，仅重建触及的祖先，并刷新重写的节点一次。

blocks.html_en: Async diff skips equal subtrees by CID and hydrates changed frontiers through ordered async batch reads when the store prefers batched reads. Streaming diff exposes the same pruning through AsyncDiffIter::next().await and into_stream().

sentences.en: Async diff skips equal subtrees by CID and hydrates changed frontiers through ordered async batch reads when the store prefers batched reads.
sentences.zh: 当存储更喜欢批量读取时，异步差异会通过 CID 跳过相等的子树，并通过有序异步批量读取来水化更改的边界。

sentences.en: Streaming diff exposes the same pruning through AsyncDiffIter::next().await and into_stream().
sentences.zh: 流式 diff 通过 AsyncDiffIter::next().await 和 into_stream() 公开相同的修剪。

blocks.html_en: Async merge uses the same delete-aware resolver model as sync merge. merge_explain preserves a typed trace across successful merges and Error::Conflict, while async CRDT merge uses the same conflict-free strategies as sync CRDT merge.

sentences.en: Async merge uses the same delete-aware resolver model as sync merge.
sentences.zh: 异步合并使用与同步合并相同的删除感知解析器模型。

sentences.en: merge_explain preserves a typed trace across successful merges and Error::Conflict, while async CRDT merge uses the same conflict-free strategies as sync CRDT merge.
sentences.zh: merge_explain 保留成功合并和 Error::Conflict 之间的类型化跟踪，而异步 CRDT 合并使用与同步 CRDT 合并相同的无冲突策略。

blocks.html_en: Append-heavy async batches use the same rightmost-path hint namespace as sync append batches, so fresh async managers can hydrate the append anchor through ordered reads.

sentences.en: Append-heavy async batches use the same rightmost-path hint namespace as sync append batches, so fresh async managers can hydrate the append anchor through ordered reads.
sentences.zh: 大量追加的异步批次使用与同步追加批次相同的最右路径提示命名空间，因此新的异步管理器可以通过有序读取来补充追加锚点。

blocks.html_en: See docs/async-store.md for the production architecture, correctness contract, visibility levels, cancellation semantics, and browser/WASM constraints.

sentences.en: See docs/async-store.md for the production architecture, correctness contract, visibility levels, cancellation semantics, and browser/WASM constraints.
sentences.zh: 请参阅 docs/async-store.md 了解生产架构、正确性契约、可见性级别、取消语义和浏览器/WASM 约束。

blocks.html_en: For async applications using blocking stores, enable the tokio feature and wrap the store with TokioBlockingStore. This runs sync store calls on Tokio's blocking thread pool instead of stalling runtime worker threads:

sentences.en: For async applications using blocking stores, enable the tokio feature and wrap the store with TokioBlockingStore.
sentences.zh: 对于使用阻塞存储的异步应用程序，启用 tokio 功能并使用 TokioBlockingStore 包装存储。

sentences.en: This runs sync store calls on Tokio's blocking thread pool instead of stalling runtime worker threads:
sentences.zh: 这会在 Tokio 的阻塞线程池上运行同步存储调用，而不是停止运行时工作线程：

sentences.en: Caches and Hints
sentences.zh: 缓存和提示

blocks.html_en: Each Prolly<S> or AsyncProlly<S> manager owns the same two engine caches:

sentences.en: Each Prolly<S> or AsyncProlly<S> manager owns the same two engine caches:
sentences.zh: 每个 Prolly<S> 或 AsyncProlly<S> 管理器都拥有相同的两个引擎缓存：

blocks.html_en: • node_cache: immutable nodes keyed by CID.

sentences.en: node_cache: immutable nodes keyed by CID.
sentences.zh: node_cache：由 CID 键控的不可变节点。

blocks.html_en: • rightmost_path_cache: the known right edge for append-heavy workloads.

sentences.en: rightmost_path_cache: the known right edge for append-heavy workloads.
sentences.zh: rightmost_path_cache：追加繁重工作负载的已知右边缘。

blocks.html_en: The decoded node cache is unbounded by default to preserve historical behavior. Use Config::builder().node_cache_max_nodes(n) to cap retained nodes, node_cache_max_bytes(bytes) to cap retained serialized node weight, or both together for a hard memory budget. Passing 0 for either cap disables node caching. Cache evictions are safe: cache misses always fall back to the backing store.

sentences.en: The decoded node cache is unbounded by default to preserve historical behavior.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，解码的节点缓存是无限制的，以保留历史行为。

sentences.en: Use Config::builder().node_cache_max_nodes(n) to cap retained nodes, node_cache_max_bytes(bytes) to cap retained serialized node weight, or both together for a hard memory budget.
sentences.zh: 使用 Config::builder().node_cache_max_nodes(n) 来限制保留的节点，使用 node_cache_max_bytes(bytes) 来限制保留的序列化节点权重，或两者一起用于硬内存预算。

sentences.en: Passing 0 for either cap disables node caching.
sentences.zh: 为任一上限传递 0 都会禁用节点缓存。

sentences.en: Cache evictions are safe: cache misses always fall back to the backing store.
sentences.zh: 缓存驱逐是安全的：缓存未命中总是回退到后备存储。

blocks.html_en: Hot snapshots can pin cache entries as a performance hint. Use pin_tree_root(&tree) when many reads will start from the same root, or pin_tree_path(&tree, key) to keep the root-to-leaf path for a hot key range in memory. Pinned entries may temporarily exceed configured cache limits; call unpin_all_cache_nodes() when the workload phase ends so normal eviction can trim the cache again. AsyncProlly exposes the same pinning APIs as async methods.

sentences.en: Hot snapshots can pin cache entries as a performance hint.
sentences.zh: 热快照可以固定缓存条目作为性能提示。

sentences.en: Use pin_tree_root(&tree) when many reads will start from the same root, or pin_tree_path(&tree, key) to keep the root-to-leaf path for a hot key range in memory.
sentences.zh: 当许多读取从同一根开始时，请使用 pin_tree_root(&tree) ，或使用 pin_tree_path(&tree, key) 在内存中保留热键范围的根到叶路径。

sentences.en: Pinned entries may temporarily exceed configured cache limits; call unpin_all_cache_nodes() when the workload phase ends so normal eviction can trim the cache again.
sentences.zh: 固定条目可能会暂时超出配置的缓存限制；当工作负载阶段结束时调用 unpin_all_cache_nodes() ，以便正常驱逐可以再次修剪缓存。

sentences.en: AsyncProlly exposes the same pinning APIs as async methods.
sentences.zh: AsyncProlly 公开与异步方法相同的固定 API。

blocks.html_en: Stores may also persist performance hints. Hint-capable stores can store a rightmost-path hint alongside node writes so a fresh sync or async manager can hydrate the append anchor with ordered batch reads. Hints are never required for correctness; callers always have a normal traversal fallback.

sentences.en: Stores may also persist performance hints.
sentences.zh: 商店还可能保留性能提示。

sentences.en: Hint-capable stores can store a rightmost-path hint alongside node writes so a fresh sync or async manager can hydrate the append anchor with ordered batch reads.
sentences.zh: 支持提示的存储可以将最右边的路径提示与节点写入一起存储，因此新的同步或异步管理器可以通过有序的批量读取来补充附加锚点。

sentences.en: Hints are never required for correctness; callers always have a normal traversal fallback.
sentences.zh: 从来不需要提示来保证正确性；调用者总是有一个正常的遍历回退。

blocks.html_en: For hot prefix ranges, sync managers can explicitly persist and hydrate a root-to-leaf path hint. This is useful when a service repeatedly scans the same tenant, workspace, document, or index shard from fresh workers:

sentences.en: For hot prefix ranges, sync managers can explicitly persist and hydrate a root-to-leaf path hint.
sentences.zh: 对于热前缀范围，同步管理器可以显式地保留并补充根到叶路径提示。

sentences.en: This is useful when a service repeatedly scans the same tenant, workspace, document, or index shard from fresh workers:
sentences.zh: 当服务重复扫描来自新工作人员的相同租户、工作区、文档或索引分片时，这非常有用：

blocks.html_en: If the hint is absent, stale, malformed, or points to missing nodes, hydration returns false and ordinary tree traversal remains correct.

sentences.en: If the hint is absent, stale, malformed, or points to missing nodes, hydration returns false and ordinary tree traversal remains correct.
sentences.zh: 如果提示不存在、陈旧、格式错误或指向丢失的节点，则 Hydration 返回 false，并且普通的树遍历仍然正确。

blocks.html_en: Writers that already know affected key ranges can also persist recently changed span hints for background indexing or sync jobs:

sentences.en: Writers that already know affected key ranges can also persist recently changed span hints for background indexing or sync jobs:
sentences.zh: 已经知道受影响的键范围的编写者还可以为后台索引或同步作业保留最近更改的跨度提示：

blocks.html_en: Changed-span hints are advisory. They are useful when the producer is trusted or when a worker wants to prioritize likely-hot ranges, but callers can always fall back to full diff, range_diff, or structural_diff_page for authoritative change discovery.

sentences.en: Changed-span hints are advisory.
sentences.zh: 更改跨度提示是建议性的。

sentences.en: They are useful when the producer is trusted or when a worker wants to prioritize likely-hot ranges, but callers can always fall back to full diff, range_diff, or structural_diff_page for authoritative change discovery.
sentences.zh: 当生产者受到信任或工作人员想要优先考虑可能的热门范围时，它们非常有用，但调用者始终可以回退到完整 diff、range_diff 或 Structure_diff_page 来进行权威的更改发现。

blocks.html_en: Use clear_cache() after tests or external store maintenance that intentionally mutates the backing store outside the Prolly API. Use cache_len() and cache_bytes_len() to inspect current node-cache size. Use cache_pinned_len() and cache_pinned_bytes_len() to inspect pinned entries.

sentences.en: Use clear_cache() after tests or external store maintenance that intentionally mutates the backing store outside the Prolly API.
sentences.zh: 在测试或外部存储维护后使用clear_cache()，故意改变 Prolly API 外部的后备存储。

sentences.en: Use cache_len() and cache_bytes_len() to inspect current node-cache size.
sentences.zh: 使用cache_len() 和cache_bytes_len() 检查当前节点缓存大小。

sentences.en: Use cache_pinned_len() and cache_pinned_bytes_len() to inspect pinned entries.
sentences.zh: 使用cache_pinned_len()和cache_pinned_bytes_len()来检查固定条目。

content_html_zh:
Prolly 发布了 prolly Rust 库箱。 用户依赖于 prolly-map 包，而代码导入保持简洁：使用 prolly::{Config, Prolly};。

该板条箱提供了内容寻址的 Prolly 树存储原语：基于字节键和字节值的不可变的、有序的键值索引，具有稳定的内容派生结构，用于高效的结构共享、差异、合并和批量加载。

在 API 边界，树是一个小的持久句柄：

  • root：Option<Cid> 指向内容寻址的根节点。
  • config：Config记录了树使用的分块和编码参数。

实际节点位于可插入存储中。 操作仅克隆和重写受影响的路径或子树，写入新的内容寻址节点，并返回新的树句柄。

所有存储支持的树工作均由运行时中立、异步优先的引擎实现一次。 AsyncProlly<S:AsyncStore> 直接使用它； Prolly<S: Store> 通过内联只读适配器驱动相同的完整操作。 同步路径不会创建运行时、停放线程或将存储调用分派给 Tokio。

建筑学

对于更喜欢光栅图像的上下文，同一图表也呈现为diagram/prolly-tree-architecture@2x.png。

完整的最终用户文档集位于 docs/ 中，其中包含入门材料、指南、食谱、架构、设计规范、实施说明、路线图和语言移植指南。 规范的食谱是 docs/cookbook.md。 本机近似最近邻索引记录在 docs/proximity-map.md 中。 重大变更和发布资格记录在 CHANGELOG.md 中。

交互式可视化工具

3rd/prolly-tree-vismizer 中的浏览器应用程序针对此存储库的真实 @crabbuild/prolly-wasm 绑定执行突变，并呈现生成的内容寻址树、查找路径、结构差异和存储历史记录。

对于想要在 prolly 树之上建立类似 Git 的存储库层的应用程序构建者，请参阅建议的 prolly-vcs 设计。 它使 prolly-map 专注于不可变的有序映射，同时概述了一个单独的箱子，其中包含用于提交、引用、引用日志、补丁、合并编排、同步计划和存储库级 GC 的通用后端中立 KvStore 底层。

这个箱子给你什么

  • 使用字典键排序的有序字节键查找。
  • 不可变更新：放置、删除和批量返回新树。
  • 内容寻址节点：每个节点 CID 是确定性节点字节的 SHA-256 哈希值。
  • 使用 xxHash64 边界检查的确定性内容定义分块。
  • 版本之间的结构共享，因为未更改的节点保留相同的 CID。
  • 通过修剪相等的 CID 和不相交的子跨度来实现高效的差异和范围差异。
  • 具有冲突解决程序支持的三向合并。
  • CRDT 风格的无冲突合并策略。
  • 惰性范围迭代和基于游标的遍历。
  • 用于排序、分组、追加和多叶写入的批量突变路径。
  • 用于大型初始树的并行批量构建器。
  • 通过 Store 特征的可插拔存储，具有内存、SQLite 和可选的 RocksDB 实现。
  • Merkle 风格的缺失节点规划和复制助手用于存储同步。
  • 用于分支、标记、检查点和自定义根的快照命名空间帮助程序。
  • 事务安全的 VersionedMap 外观，具有自动头、不可变的内容派生版本、固定读取、证明、比较和合并、备份/同步、类型化编解码器、订阅、多映射事务、有界历史记录和范围 GC。
  • 严格的 IndexedMap 协调器，用于运行时定义的非唯一二级索引，具有单根原子发布、有限操作预算、稀疏和多值术语、KeysOnly/Include/All 投影、精确历史快照、持久引脚、安全 GC、结构化诊断和经过验证的有界传输。 应用程序通过相同的engine.indexed_map(...)打开它 Prolly 或 AsyncProlly 上的形状；两条路径都使用相同的规范状态格式和严格的事务根发布。 对 PostgreSQL、MySQL、Redis、Turso、DynamoDB、Cosmos DB 和 Spanner 提供一流的本机异步支持，并在阻塞应用程序需要时提供同步外观。
  • 树根的存储独立单密钥、共享多密钥、完整范围、光标页面和差异页面证明。
  • 用于检查形状、填充因子、扇出和序列化大小的树统计数据。
  • 硬切确定性邻近图，具有精确查找、过滤最佳优先搜索、本地化规范 COW、溢出/外部向量、SQ8/PQ/HNSW 加速、异步/SIMD 执行、类型化复制/GC 和描述符绑定证明。

快速启动

use prolly::{Config, MemStore, Prolly};

let store = MemStore::new();
let prolly = Prolly::new(store, Config::default());

let tree = prolly.create();
let tree = prolly
    .put(&tree, b"name".to_vec(), b"Alice".to_vec())
    .unwrap();

let value = prolly.get(&tree, b"name").unwrap();
assert_eq!(value, Some(b"Alice".to_vec()));

let tree = prolly.delete(&tree, b"name").unwrap();
assert!(prolly.get(&tree, b"name").unwrap().is_none());

所有更新 API 都是持久的。 只要存储仍然包含它引用的节点，旧的树句柄就保持有效。

独立结账

该目录可以作为其自己的存储库打开。 此树下的 Rust 清单声明了自己的包元数据、依赖项版本和 lint 设置。

从存储库根运行核心箱：

cargo check --all-targets
cargo test
cargo run --example basic_map
